TO GUARD THE TOMB OF THE FRENCH EMKONN WARRIER.

M. Marcel Gardin, an ex-soldier of the French Army who was wounded during the war, has been appointed to Guard the Tomb of the French Unknown Warrior - M. Marcel Gardin, an ex-soldier of the French Army who was wounded during the war, has been appointed to Guard the Tomb of the French Unknown Warrior and to see that the Holy Flame never burns out. This is the first time that such a guard has been appointed.

O.P.S. M. Marcel Gardin, photographed whilst guarding the Flame on the bomb of the French Unknown Warrior in Paris.

GOLD STAR MOthers OF FRANCE REMEMBER
THE IR HERCES BY FLORAL SHRINE.

As a remembrance of those who made the supreme sacrifice in the war gold star mothers of France have placed a little alter in the home and before which rests small floral plants as a means of dedicating the names of their loved ones who fought the good fight and now lay beneath the soil of their country. Each plant on theutar is named for one soldier. In this picture an aged mother has lost four of her sons and is here seen tenderly watering her plants.
